answer: Re-attestations are stored in ivory and echo lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, which means holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the sparrow graph. A farm of 3914 identities would post 719 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
